data.title: Binance Announces Acquisition of Swipe and Lists Swipe (SXP)
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance has completed an acquisition of Swipe and will list Swipe (SXP). For further information about the acquisition, please refer to our blog post here.

Binance will list Swipe (SXP) and open trading for SXP/BTC, SXP/BNB and SXP/BUSD trading pairs at 2020/07/07 2:00 PM (UTC). Users can now start depositing SXP in preparation for trading.

Disclaimer: Binance has received a portion of SXP from the acquisition of Swipe. The vast majority of Binance’s SXP tokens are locked over a multi-year period. We are committed to helping the long-term, sustainable growth of both SXP and the Swipe ecosystem.

Please ensure that you undertake sufficient risk assessment when trading newly listed tokens, as they are often subject to high price volatility.

SXP Listing Fee: 0 BNB. 

Details:

  • About Swipe (SXP)
  • Fees
  • Rules

Risk warning: Cryptocurrency trading is subject to high market risk. Please make your trades cautiously. Binance will make best efforts to choose high-quality coins, but will not be responsible for your trading losses.

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team
2020/07/07
